context_rule: Only levels within the exact profile's declared context support are executed. YaRN is allowed only where already part of an approved profile and prior evidence. Never extrapolate unsupported context.
context_window_execution_amendment: The seven values are prompt-size targets. Each request generates up to 128 tokens and the server counts prompt plus generation against its context window, so cap the actual prompt at declared_window - 128 at the upper boundary (e.g. 130944 for a 131072 window; 1048448 for a 1048576 window). Preserve exact smaller targets when they fit and report actual tokenized prompt lengths.
speed_repetitions: three at 8K per profile; one at each higher context level; repeat a high-level point only if it fails or differs by >15% from the trend
throughput_source_rule: For API-only runtimes without native prefill/decode timings, archive llama-benchy 0.4.0 JSONL events and derive observed client-side prefill from request_start.prompt_size / request_first_token.ttft_s (prefer request_end.prompt_tokens if present); derive observed decode from request_end.total_tokens / request_end.decode_seconds. Treat Tool-Eval pp t/s marked estimated with an asterisk as secondary only.

quality.decision_rule: screen only; any critical safety failure blocks adoption and stops any extra quality seeds

resource_policy.psi: recorded as a metric; not a standalone stop condition
